notes.subject: feat(tools): capture observed impact in feedback reports
notes.summary: Development-build send_feedback reports now require an observed_impact field and accept optional workaround, recurrence and improvement-signal context, which get_feedback returns.

notes.subject: fix(tools): redact credential output and preserve final newlines
notes.summary: Command output now redacts values on environment-style TOKEN/SECRET/API_KEY/PASSWORD lines, and cleaned output keeps leading whitespace and final newlines.

notes.subject: fix(tools): repair branch queries and compose recovery
notes.summary: Read-only git branch queries are recognised, and compose gives clearer path-approval recovery, newline-split list_files guidance and syntax error locations.

notes.subject: fix(webview): reset transcript scroll state when switching chat tabs
notes.summary: Switching chat tabs now opens the transcript at the latest message instead of keeping the previous scroll position.

notes.subject: fix(webview): group successful skill loads with tool calls
notes.summary: Successful skill loads now group with adjacent tool calls in the Tools summary and are counted as loaded skills.

notes.subject: fix(tools): redact search secrets and bound read results
notes.summary: search_files and semantic search redact secrets in structured config files, excerpts are length-bounded, and list_files honours an explicit root inside node_modules.

notes.subject: fix(codex): restore Responses Lite thinking summaries
notes.summary: Codex Responses Lite requests again return detailed reasoning summaries, so thinking blocks appear for GPT-6 models.

notes.subject: fix(tools): improve git recovery and diagnostic attribution
notes.summary: Edit diagnostics are scoped to the edited file, Git metadata recovery covers more Git-only command chains, and GitHub TLS failure recovery is recognised in mixed commands.

notes.subject: fix(agent): inline todo_write item schema and name missing fields
notes.summary: The todo_write schema is inlined so required item fields stay visible to providers, and ignored items now report which fields were missing.

notes.subject: fix(tools): preserve save failures and classify page and pipe results
notes.summary: Save failures now report the exception message with redaction, Codex page-access 'Internal Error' responses are treated as failures, and substitution pipelines no longer trip output-filter checks.

notes.subject: fix(tools): clarify proposal failures and edit recovery
notes.summary: Memory proposal review-open failures return structured recovery evidence, and format-on-save conflict hints and apply_diff marker guidance are clearer.

notes.subject: fix(tools): preserve command failure evidence and recovery
notes.summary: Sandbox helper failures return structured evidence with terminal and command IDs, Git lock recovery is improved, and approval audit events are recorded separately.

notes.subject: fix(tools): preserve command input and improve sandbox recovery
notes.summary: Command recovery improves: protected-root drift and Docker socket guidance, host-HOME handling for mise/asdf, curl connect-timeout diagnosis, and running command input files are preserved.

notes.subject: fix(webview): add copy action to transcript image preview
notes.summary: The transcript image preview now has a Copy image button that writes a PNG to the clipboard where supported.

notes.subject: fix(webview): make context-menu Copy copy right-clicked images
notes.summary: Choosing Copy in the context menu after right-clicking a transcript image now copies the image to the clipboard.

notes.subject: fix(core): forward tool-result images on OpenAI-compatible providers
notes.summary: Images returned by tools are now forwarded to image-capable OpenAI-compatible models in the following user message instead of being replaced by an omission placeholder.

notes.subject: feat: add desktop quick ask and consolidate agent tools
notes.summary: Adds Desktop menu bar, Quick Ask panel with global shortcut, and open-at-login settings; consolidates get_context and codebase_search into read_file and search_files, and enables hosted web search and routine Git approvals.

notes.subject: feat(tools): support team skill targets and context symbol suppression
notes.summary: Adds a skill_directory option so propose_memory can target team skills in .agents/skills, and include_symbols=false now works in both read_file views.

notes.subject: fix(tools): harden edit recovery, context previews, and command reporting
notes.summary: Hardens edit save-failure recovery and native command launch confirmation, bounds read_file context previews with character-offset paging, and improves compound-command network failure guidance.

notes.subject: fix(browser-gateway): restore full tool details in desktop and ask agent
notes.summary: Desktop and Ask Agent now show full expandable tool and skill details (inputs, outputs, media) loaded on demand via a new transcript block-detail protocol operation.

notes.subject: feat: add desktop MCP management and harden agent recovery
notes.summary: Desktop gains an MCP manager window with connection, OAuth and approval controls; agent recovery, diagnostics, and command review evidence improve, and the SDK adds human question-answer binding types.

notes.subject: fix(tools): resolve stale terminal cwd and patch preflight feedback
notes.summary: Native terminal commands now recover from stale working directories, apply_diff handles @@ headers inside SEARCH/REPLACE blocks, and Git preflight recognizes more safe staging patterns.

notes.subject: feat(chat): add transcript jump buttons for previous prompt and latest output
notes.summary: Chat transcripts now show floating buttons to jump to the previous user prompt or back to the latest output.

notes.subject: feat(approvals): bind Guardian approvals to the human input they reviewed
notes.summary: Guardian approvals now account for queued and newly entered human input, re-review when input arrives mid-review, and block stale commands at terminal dispatch with an authorization_stale result.

notes.subject: feat(approvals): keep a private per-session record of verified human decisions
notes.summary: Each session keeps a private record of verified human instructions and answers, so earlier restrictions still reach Guardian after condensation, with rewind pruning and a dedicated review budget.

notes.subject: feat(release): plan semantic releases on main and install every surface
notes.summary: The installer can now install the VS Code, Desktop, or CLI surface with checksum verification, version pinning and dry-run, and an SDK installer vendors verified archives; release planning is automated.
